modelConfig.intro: Manage multiple AI model profiles. The active profile is used for AI Assistant, host AI ops, and your scheduled/triggered tasks.
modelConfig.importHint: Paste JSON or choose a file. Supports export format (profiles array) or a single profile object.
modelConfig.importModeIncremental: Keep existing; import new only (skip same name)
modelConfig.importModeOverwrite: Overwrite same name and import new
modelConfig.namePh: Profile name, e.g. Prod Qwen, Local Ollama
modelConfig.settingsMovedHint: AI model settings have moved to Model configuration.
